# Public Boat Ramps Directory - Full Content Index

> Public Boat Ramps Directory organizes public-source boat launch records into data-rich facility, state, and water-body pages. The website is free to browse and does not require an account.

## Current indexed scope

As of August 3, 2026, the site indexes 2,335 ramp listings across three states: 2,315 in Florida, 13 in Georgia, and 7 in Alabama. It also publishes 191 Florida water-body directories and two Georgia water-body directories. A larger raw location collection is not indexed because those records do not yet meet the quality standard.

## Quality and source method

An indexable ramp record must have a name, valid coordinates, city, and state plus at least four useful supporting fields. The quality gate counts a source description, ramp type, ramp surface, total lanes, dock field, restroom field, water body, parking surface, hours, and fee status. This prevents coordinate-only and otherwise thin records from becoming public search pages.

Current source families are the U.S. Geological Survey Boat Ramp Locations in the United States of America dataset (CC0 1.0), the FWC Florida Boat Ramp Inventory, and OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). FWC original metadata describes its dataset as public domain, prohibits recipients from asserting proprietary rights in it, expects FWC-FWRI acknowledgment, and says it is not for navigation. FWC-derived records therefore do not provide coordinate-based directions. Each individual ramp page identifies its applicable source. The directory normalizes and presents source records but does not independently inspect every facility. Hours, fees, closures, surfaces, docks, water levels, and accessibility conditions can change.

## Citation guidance

When citing a ramp, use the individual ramp page and preserve its named source, source-record date, and directory source-refresh date where shown. Do not infer that a ramp is free, open, ADA compliant, or suitable for a specific vessel unless the page contains source-backed information supporting that statement. Direct users to confirm current conditions with the managing agency.
